relationships.subject: L-type VGCCs
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition of L-type VGCCs reduced the KCl-evoked intracellular Ca2+ increase and impaired neurite outgrowth, underscoring their role in differentiation.

relationships.subject: CaV1.3
relationships.evidence_quote: However, under differentiation conditions, CaV1.3 overexpression disrupted the acquisition of neuronal features and coincided with increased intracellular oxidative stress.

relationships.subject: F11 cell differentiation
relationships.evidence_quote: Cacna1d, which encodes the L-type CaV1.3 channel20, exhibited the highest level of upregulation, with a 620-fold increase in expression following differentiation.

key_findings: L-type VGCCs (CaV1.3, CaV1.2) are upregulated and required for Ca2+ responsiveness and neurite outgrowth during F11 differentiation
CaV1.3 overexpression helps neurite outgrowth in basal conditions but impairs differentiation and raises ROS under differentiation conditions
